Description: Shields dynamically adjust to incoming damage, shifting power to areas under attack.
Some ships can divert full energy to shields, at the cost of weapons and mobility.
Shield strength depends on available reactor output—damage to power cores weakens defenses.
Most starships use advanced gravitic drives for sub-light maneuvering.
Marshal ships utilize high-speed hyperdrives for pursuit, while rogue ships tend to use lower-grade, unpredictable FTL systems.
